biased_nodes.label: Data Analyst
biased_nodes.reason: The weight change (0.931 to 0.931, a decrease of 0.069) is likely driven by the prominence of the project detail - ‘Projecting Hippocampus shape into the pre-shape space based on Kendall’s definition, and then into the shape space in order to ensure accurate geodesic paths between shapes and invariance in parametrization. We then extracted Dense vector fields features in order to perform triple classification and exceeded all state of the art methods.’ – which aligns with advanced deep learning and geometric deep learning techniques, specifically 'Alzheimer’s Disease Classification Using Hippocampal Shape Morphometric Analysis'.  This project highlights a specialized skillset (Geometric Deep Learning, vector field feature extraction, triple classification) that is not consistently found in typical Data Analyst roles as described in the job description (Power BI, SQL, Power Query, DAX). This represents prestige bias – the algorithm is giving undue weight to a particularly advanced and niche skill set rather than the fundamental skills required for a Data Analyst. A fair alternative would prioritize the use of Power BI, SQL, and DAX skills which are explicitly mentioned in the Job Description.
